visual_review.method: Poppler 150dpi full-page rendering, 6page contact sheets and individual changed/critical pages
visual_review.note: Some full-page preview displays appeared to omit leading glyphs. Enlarged direct pixel crops confirmed complete glyphs in the saved raster. No PDF or raster defect was established. Genuine system Poppler24.02.0 was used for final rendering. This preview-display artifact is distinct from the actual initial figure-margin clipping, which was corrected.
visual_review.independent_team_review_scope: Root, literature and computation reviewers inspect current assigned pages separately.
